subject: 英语
source: 人教版PEP小学英语（三年级起点）教材单元话题整理
original_text:
【核心词汇】clothes 衣服; hat 帽子; dress 连衣裙; skirt 短裙; coat 外套; shirt 衬衫; sweater 毛衣; sock 袜子; shorts 短裤; jacket 夹克; pants 裤子
【重点句型】Are these/those ...? 这些/那些是……吗？ Yes, they are. / No, they aren't. 是的。/ 不是。 Whose ... is this? 这是谁的……？ It's ... 它是……的。 Put on ... / Take off ... 穿上……/ 脱下……
【A Let's talk】Sarah: Are these yours, Mike? Mike: No, they aren't. My shoes are blue. Sarah: Whose coat is this? Chen Jie: It's mine. Sarah: And those? Chen Jie: They're John's.
【Read and write】I have many clothes. I have a red dress, a blue skirt, a yellow coat and white socks. This shirt is mine. Those pants are my father's. I put on my sweater. It is cold today.
key_points: Are these/those ...? 这些/那些是……吗？
Yes, they are. / No, they aren't. 是的。/ 不是。
Whose ... is this? 这是谁的……？
Put on ... / Take off ... 穿上……/ 脱下……
cautions: 只做内容骨架（核心词汇、重点句型、对话与短文范例），不生成老师逐字讲解稿；词汇与句型均依据该 PEP 单元目标语言整理，不得编造教材未出现的单词、语法点或例句。
